name: keyword-planner-pp-mcp
description: Turn Google Keyword Planner reads into an immutable local evidence portfolio for offline research and safe warehouse handoff.

google_ads_client_id.title: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID
google_ads_client_id.description: Sets GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID for the Google Keyword Planner MCP server.

google_ads_client_secret.title: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
google_ads_client_secret.description: Sets GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET for the Google Keyword Planner MCP server.

google_ads_customer_id.title: GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID
google_ads_customer_id.description: Sets GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID for the Google Keyword Planner MCP server.

google_ads_developer_token.title: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
google_ads_developer_token.description: Sets GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN for the Google Keyword Planner MCP server.

google_ads_login_customer_id.title: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
google_ads_login_customer_id.description: Optional manager login context. The operating target is configured separately with GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID.

google_ads_refresh_token.title: GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
google_ads_refresh_token.description: Sets GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN for the Google Keyword Planner MCP server.

keyword_planner_base_url.title: KEYWORD_PLANNER_BASE_URL
keyword_planner_base_url.description: Optional. Sets KEYWORD_PLANNER_BASE_URL for the Google Keyword Planner MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.

keyword_planner_user_agent.title: KEYWORD_PLANNER_USER_AGENT
keyword_planner_user_agent.description: Optional. Sets KEYWORD_PLANNER_USER_AGENT for the Google Keyword Planner MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.
